title: 「インド太平洋」構想を進化　エネルギー・安保連携を拡充　高市首相、ベトナムで外交演説
extracted_text: 【ハノイ＝小沢慶太】高市早苗首相は2日、ベトナム・ハノイのベトナム国家大学で外交政策について演説を行った。海洋進出や経済的威圧を強める中国や、グローバルサウス（南半球を中心とする新興・途上国）の台頭などを念頭に、外交方針に掲げる構想「自由で開かれたインド太平洋（FOIP）」を「進化」させると表明し、エネルギー・重要物資の供給網強化や安全保障連携の拡充を打ち出した。 FOIPは2016年、当時の安倍晋三首相がアジアとアフリカをまたぐ外交構想として発表した。高市首相は演説で国際情勢の変化に合わせて地域の各国が、経済や安保の面で「自律性」と「強靱性」を身に付けることがFOIPの実現に不可欠だと訴えた。 ホルムズ海峡の事実上の封鎖に伴うエネルギー危機は「FOIP実現へ日本の覚悟を試す出来事だ」と強調。アジア各国などに対する原油の調達支援や備蓄・放出システムの構築、省エネ化に取り組む方針を示した。 また、各国の最重要課題は「AI・データ時代の競争を勝ち抜くことだ」との認識を示した。「FOIPデジタル回廊構想」として、アジアの多様な言語・文化を反映したAIモデルの開発、大量のデータ通信に必要なインフラ整備への支援を表明した。 シーレーン（海上交通路）の確保など海洋安全保障の重要性も指摘した。「自由な海、開かれた海を守るために協力を惜しまない」とし、東南アジア諸国に対し、政府開発援助（ODA）や政府安全保障能力強化支援（OSA）を活用した支援の拡充を約束した。 こうした日本の主体的な取り組みにより「インド太平洋地域全体が『共に、強く豊かになる』ことができると確信している」と語った。
translated_text: [Hanoi = Keita Ozawa] Prime Minister Sanae Takeshiba delivered a speech on foreign policy at Vietnam National University in Hanoi on the 2nd. With an eye on China strengthening its maritime expansion and economic coercion, and the rise of the Global South (emerging and developing countries centered in the Southern Hemisphere), she declared that she would "evolve" the "Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP)" concept set forth in her foreign policy, and rolled out measures to strengthen supply chains for energy and critical materials and expand security cooperation. FOIP was launched in 2016 by then Prime Minister Shinzo Abe as a diplomatic concept spanning Asia and Africa. In her speech, Takeshiba emphasized that for FOIP to be realized, it is essential for countries in the region to develop "autonomy" and "resilience" in both economic and security matters in response to changes in the international situation. She stressed that the energy crisis arising from the de facto blockade of the Strait of Hormuz is "an event that tests Japan's resolve to achieve FOIP." She outlined policies including providing crude oil procurement support to Asian countries, building strategic reserve and release systems, and promoting energy conservation. She also expressed the view that the most critical challenge for each country is "to win the competition in the AI and data age." As part of the "FOIP Digital Corridor Concept," she pledged support for developing AI models that reflect Asia's diverse languages and cultures, and for building infrastructure needed for large-scale data communications. She also pointed out the importance of maritime security, including ensuring sea lanes. She stated that Japan "will spare no effort in cooperating to protect the free and open seas" and pledged to expand support to Southeast Asian countries using Official Development Assistance (ODA) and Official Security Assistance (OSA). She expressed her conviction that these proactive efforts by Japan will enable "the entire Indo-Pacific region to become strong and prosperous together."
title_en: Indo-Pacific Concept to Evolve - Energy, Security Cooperation to Expand - PM Takeshiba Delivers Speech in Vietnam
